# Panel of the batch runner for the Game Gear images of takeme/roms/gg, in
# the format of panel.txt (run with -roms takeme/roms/gg -panel this file
# -reports reports/gg). In the pad scripts, 100 is START, held on port $00
# as long as the bit is set.
#
# The scripts aim at reaching the game itself, then at simple inputs that
# keep it busy. The cartridges cover the Game Gear's own mechanisms (the
# 12-bit colour RAM, the LCD window, START on port $00, the PSG stereo
# register) with games of different kinds: platform games with fast
# scrolling and many sprites (Sonic Triple Trouble, Tails Adventures,
# Shinobi II), a vertical shooter (Power Strike II), fighting games with
# large sprites (Fatal Fury, Arena), role-playing games with cartridge RAM
# and dialogue boxes (Defenders of Oasis, Sylvan Tale), a sports game with
# a scrolling pitch (Sensible Soccer). Virtua Fighter Animation, a 1 MiB
# image, does not load (images up to 512 KiB fit).
#
# The entries are plays recorded on Phoenix (the `Pad script:` line of each
# log, written by the ISO's pad recorder), which the model replays frame for
# frame.
#
# cartridge                 frames  pad script
